      $('.zoomDiv').css({opacity: '1', width: 'auto', border: '1px solid white', borderRadius: '5px', position: 'fixed', top: '50%', left: '50%', marginRight: '-50%', transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)', boxShadow: '0px 0px 50px #888888', zIndex: '50', overflow: 'auto', maxHeight: '100%'});

```{r lib, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

cog_summary <- "input_cog.txt"
myco_summary <- "input_MycoBrowser.txt"
input_sum <- "input_summary.txt"

colors <- c("L5"="#995200","L6"="#1eb040","A1"="#d1ae00","A4"="#ff9cdb","A2"="#8ef5c8", "A3"="#73c2ff", "L4"="#ff0000","L1"="#ff3091", "L2"="#001aff", "L3" ="#8a0bd2", "L7"="#fbff00", "L8"="#ff9d00","L9"="#37ff30", "L10"="#8fbda1")
name <- c("A" = "A - RNA processing and modification", "B" = "B - Chromatin structure and dynamics", "C" = "C - Energy production and conversion", "D" = "D - Cell cycle control, cell division, chromosome partitioning", "E" = "E - Amino acid transport and metabolism", "F" = "F - Nucleotide transport and metabolism", "G" = "G - Carbohydrate transport and metabolism", "H" = "H - Coenzyme transport and metabolism", "I" = "I - Lipid transport and metabolism", "J" = "J - Translation, ribosomal structure and biogenesis", "K" = "K - Transcription", "L" = "L - Replication, recombination and repair", "M" = "M - Cell wall/membrane/envelope biogenesis", "N" = "N - Cell motility", "O" = "O - Posttranslational modification, protein turnover, chaperones", "P" = "P - Inorganic ion transport and metabolism", "Q" = "Q - Secondary metabolites biosynthesis, transport and catabolism", "R" = "R - General function prediction only", "S" = "S - Function unknown", "T" = "T - Signal transduction mechanisms", "U" = "U - Intracellular trafficking, secretion, and vesicular transport", "V" = "V - Defense mechanisms", "W" = "W - Extracellular structures", "X" = "X - Mobilome: prophages, transposons", "Y" = "Y - Nuclear structure", "Z" = "Z - Cytoskeleton", "NaN"="None")
datos_cog <- read.table(cog_summary, sep = "\t", dec=".")
colnames(datos_cog)<- c("Lineages","genome","Functional_Category","Count","Percentage")
datos_cog$sequences <- with(datos_cog, paste(Lineages, genome, sep = "_"))
datos_cog$Percentage<-as.numeric(datos_cog$Percentage)

datos_myco <- read.table(myco_summary, sep = "\t", dec=".")
colnames(datos_myco)<- c("Lineages","genome","Functional_Category","Count","Percentage")
datos_myco$sequences <- with(datos_myco, paste(Lineages, genome, sep = "_"))
datos_myco$Percentage<-as.numeric(datos_myco$Percentage)

my_myco <- data.frame(
  lineage = c(rep("L4", 11)),
  genome = c(rep("H37Rv", 11)),
  Functional_Category = c("PE/PPE", "cell wall and cell processes", "conserved hypotheticals", "information pathways", "insertion seqs and phages", "intermediary metabolism and respiration", "lipid metabolism", "regulatory proteins", "unknown", "virulence, detoxification, adaptation", ""),
  count = c(162, 766, 1042, 240, 149, 936, 271, 198, 15, 239, 13),
  percentage = c(4.018853882411312, 19.00272885140164, 25.8496650955098, 5.953857603572314, 3.696353262217812, 23.220044653932025, 6.722897544033739, 4.9119325229471595, 0.37211610022326963, 5.92904986355743, 0.3225006201935004)
)
merged_data <- merge(my_myco, datos_myco, by = "Functional_Category", all = TRUE)
merged_data$Ratio_Percentage <- (merged_data$Count / merged_data$count) * 100
```

# AMAP CDS Results {.tabset}
## CDS Boxplot
```{r cds_boxplot, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data <- read.table(input_sum, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", dec=".")
order_lineages <- rev(c("A4", "A3", "A2", "A1","L10","L9","L6","L5","L4","L3","L2","L7","L1","L8"))
data$V4 <- factor(data$V4, levels = order_lineages)

counts <- data %>% 
  group_by(V4, V1) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), y_pos = max(V2) + 1)

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = V4, y = V2, color = V4)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = counts, aes(x = V4, y = y_pos, label = n, color = V4), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ V1, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of CDS") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.5)) 

print(p)
```

## CDS Violinplot
```{r cds_violin, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
means <- data %>% 
  group_by(V4, V1) %>% 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(V2), y_pos = max(V2) + 1)

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = V4, y = V2, color = V4)) +
  geom_violin(fill = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = means, aes(x = V4, y = y_pos, label = round(mean_value, 2), color = V4), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ V1, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of CDS") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.5)) 

print(p)
```
